summary: Valneva SE on June 25, 2026, issued a press release reporting the successful outcome of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) held that day in Lyon. All resolutions recommended by the Board were approved, including the 2025 financial statements, renewal of share capital authorizations, transfer of the registered office, and reappointment of five Board members. At a subsequent Board meeting, Dr. Gerd Zettlmeissl was appointed Chair, succeeding Anne-Marie Graffin (who remains Vice-chair). This is a routine AGM outcome with ordinary director appointments; no special-situation event such as a forced management departure, acquisition, or restructuring is present.
